summary: Diff adds new backend fields (permitNumber, furnishingStatus, numberOfWashrooms), updates agent create/edit flow to send them, displays permit/washrooms in listing card, adds furnishing-status filter plumbing in PropertySearchBar/useSearchProperties, and adds a backend query by furnishing status. However, it also introduces a new backend migration module and pulls authorization mixins/access-control into backend/main.mo, which were not requested and may conflict with the constraint that backend logic remain in backend/main.mo.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a backend migration module (backend/migration.mo) and wired it into the actor via `(with migration = Migration.run)` rather than keeping all backend logic solely in backend/main.mo.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constraint requires: "Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo". Adding backend/migration.mo adds backend logic outside main.mo; migration was not explicitly requested as part of REQ-25..28.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/changed backend authorization architecture using MixinAuthorization and AccessControl state for profile/user-role permissions.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not request an authorization refactor; it only constrained that create/update/delete property operations remain protected by agent code 050702 and that public listing queries remain public. The diff shows new authorization mixin/access-control logic beyond the requested field additions and search filter.
